content.text: As you are aware, we did a logic change in the Ataccama Collibra post processing Integration plan and as part of the change going forward all failing Metrics that have a closed issue attached to it, will have a new Issue created to track the Threshold breach (previously the closed Issue's description was getting updated without a status change)

After turning on the new logic, we are finding a lot of metrics trying to create a new Issue but the API call returning a 403 error. When we tried to debug the JSON call, the error message is as below

{"statusCode":403,"titleMessage":"Not authorized","helpMessage":"Sign in or contact your administrator to change your permissions.","userMessage":"You don't have view permissions for all the representations.","errorCode":"noViewPermissionResources","properties":{}}
This is strange as there is an already existing closed Issue attached with these metrics suggesting the behavious change of the call being a recent issue.
Can you please look into this and help us with resolving the problem so that we can flag metrics failure appropriately going forward ?
Please find a few examples of metrics that are failing to create an issue due to this 403 response below for your reference and analysis.
Kindly let me know if you need any further details from my end.
